<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 275.059 Da. A formula that matches this mass and is consistent with the observed 13C isotopic pattern (≈ 16 % M+1, indicating ~15–16 carbons) is C₁₅H₁₅O₅ (exact monoisotopic mass = 275.0919 Da, within typical experimental error). Hence the molecular formula of the sample compound is C15H15O5. </thought>
<final_answer>C15H15O5</final_answer>
